query: How do I decorate a sketchbook with stickers?

goal.title: Decorate a notebook page with stickers
goal.description: Open a spiral notebook, arrange a selection of decorative stickers on its right page, then peel their backings and press them into the planned layout.
goal.final_state: The notebook remains open on the tray. Its right page holds lettering, flower, illustrated and cactus stickers; the left page is blank. Spare stickers and discarded white backings remain beside it.

procedure.description: Open the spiral notebook to a blank lined spread on the wooden lap tray. Retrieve a stack of die-cut stickers from the right, thumb through designs and lay a small lettering design on the right page, moving it upward. Place a larger black script design below it. The stickers are initially laid out with their backing papers still attached.

Flip through further designs in the left hand and set aside one green lettering piece. Place an illustrated design at the upper right, red lettering at the lower right, a small lettering design beside the spiral and a green cactus along the right edge. Add a flower near the upper lettering and adjust nearby pieces.

Select a brown lettering design and place it near the middle right. Continue sorting the remaining stack, move unused designs aside and rearrange the loose stickers on the page to refine their spacing. Put the spare stack on the right side of the tray.

Lift the small lettering piece from the layout, work a fingernail under its white backing, peel it off and return the adhesive sticker to the upper part of the page. Press it down and put the backing on a growing pile at the tray upper right. Repeat for the illustrated upper-right design, then move the nearby loose pieces around the flower.

Lift the flower, pick and peel its backing and smooth it onto the page. Peel and attach the black lettering piece next. Lift the cactus from the layout, repeatedly work at its edge, pull off its backing, align it near the right edge and press it flat. Put the removed papers on the upper-right pile.

Move loose designs aside to reach an oval lettering sticker, peel away its backing and stick it in the central-left space. Peel and attach the large black script below it. Remove the red lettering design backing, place it on the center-right and rub it flat. Separate white backings are discarded onto the tray pile after these placements.

Take the brown lettering design from beside the notebook. Spend repeated fingernail attempts lifting its backing while holding the small piece near the bottom of view. Once separated, align it at the lower right, smooth its edges and discard the backing. Retrieve the spare sticker stack.

Select a final small design from the spare stack and work at its backing edge near the lap, with the exact edge partly hidden by the fingertips. Put its white backing on the upper-right pile, align the small sticker along the bottom of the right page and press it down. Withdraw the hands, leaving the decorated right page open beside a blank left page.

notes: All 22 human fine divisions unchanged. All seven overview sheets, all dense interval sheets and 22 native end frames inspected with native PTS burned before sampling. Initial placements are trial layout, not unsupported claims that backing was already removed. Small printed phrases are not transcribed where resolution does not support exact text. One canonical sticker object denotes individual selected designs, stack denotes the bundle; notebook contact for stabilization is not a grasp. Multiple source fine intervals include retrieval, peeling, attachment and backing disposal; boundary notes record these compound actions without changing boundaries. Two coarse subtasks reflect the two visible intermediate goals, rather than artificially dividing repeated attachment cycles. Predictability pending blind stage.

coarse.instruction: Plan the sticker layout on the notebook page
coarse.description: Open the notebook, retrieve and sort the sticker stack, choose lettering, flower, illustrated and cactus designs, lay them across the right page and repeatedly reposition them before setting the remaining stack beside the notebook.
coarse.goal_contribution: Establishes the visual arrangement before the adhesive backings are removed.

coarse.instruction: Peel and adhere the arranged stickers
coarse.description: Lift designs individually from the trial layout, use fingernails to separate their white backings, return each adhesive sticker to the page and press it flat. Adjust surrounding loose designs and accumulate the removed papers at the tray upper right; add a final small sticker at the page bottom.
coarse.goal_contribution: Secures the selected designs to create the finished decorated notebook page.
coarse.predictability_reason: The planned sticker layout is ready to adhere to the page.
